lines.text: Another hole has been torn open in the Dome of Eternity.
Enikk is able to respond quickly thanks to her prior experience.
She calculates where the Raptures will land and seals off the area within a four-kilometer radius.
As she does, she imposes a media blackout.
She deploys optical camouflage developed by Eden and conceals both the breach in the Dome and the sealed area.
Civilians know there's a disturbance within the sealed area,
but have no way of knowing what's causing it.
Enikk deploys all nearby Nikkes and unmanned units.
The Raptures that entered the Ark are immediately funneled into a confined zone.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Ultimate attack! Ark Black Meteor!
*Boom!*
Ark Ranger Black crushes a Rapture's core with her kick.
The Rapture collapses in silence.
Two more approach, shaking the ground with their steps.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Ark Blaster! Activate!
Mechanical clicks ring through the air,
as the device on Ark Ranger Black's right arm changes shape.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Crying Black! Fire!
She thrusts her arm forward and a barrage of gunfire erupts.
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat!*
Both Raptures detonate in small explosions and tumble to the ground.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... Victory.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Wait, since when can you take down Raptures like that?

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Are those live rounds you're using?

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: My body and weapon systems are all combat-grade.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I've honed myself, both to be the perfect clown...

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: and to step out beyond the screen...

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Hyaaaah!
*Boom!*
Moran sends a Rapture reeling with a roundhouse kick,
and Ark Ranger Black fires at its core.
The Rapture collapses, and for a brief moment, the surroundings fall silent.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Ugh! Why didn't I bring my weapon?!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... I'm amazed you can fight Raptures without one.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Well, I've got experience.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Besides, you're really impressive yourself, flying around like that with a combat-grade body and actual weapons.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: You could do it too. I'll teach you a few tricks if you're interested.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Sounds good, but let's deal with these guys first.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Yeah. Let's do this.
Moran and Ark Ranger Black charge forward.
Ark Rangers Red and Blue stand dumbstruck for a moment, then follow after them.
The situation quickly begins to settle.
Having learned from the previous attacks on the Ark, Enikk has the situation under complete control.
Not a single Rapture escapes the containment zone, and the deployed Nikkes are delivering results.
Moran and Ark Ranger Black take down every Rapture in sight,
while Ark Rangers Red and Blue focus on rescuing trapped civilians.
After that continues for some time,
Ark Ranger Black notices the surroundings have grown quiet.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: ... I think that's all of them.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Any casualties?

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: None from what we saw.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Phew... Everyone did great. What a mess, and right in the middle of filming.
Ark Ranger Black looks down at her hands.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... Hope.
Suddenly she hears something.
The sound of someone running at full speed. She lifts her head.
She sees Hope running.
Behind him, a Rapture gives chase.
Ark Ranger Black shuts her eyes tight and shakes her head hard.
She must be seeing things.
She opens her eyes again.
Hope is still running, and the Rapture is still chasing him.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Rapture!

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Hey! Snap out of it!
Ark Ranger Black starts running and everyone follows behind her.
A frightened boy comes into her view, together with a Rapture standing in front of him.
It's like the nightmare from before is happening all over again.
She remembers back to that time, back to when she pompously believed she could do anything.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: But... this time will be different!
Ark Ranger Black once again steps in front of the boy.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... I'm here, kid.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Ark Ranger... Black...
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
The Rapture fires a barrage of bullets.
Ark Ranger Black hunches down and blocks every shot with her body.
Parts of her body shatter and splinter, but she does not fall.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Black!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Never again...

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I won't let anyone die again!
The boy looks up at her.
Ark Ranger Black unleashes an Ark Black Meteor right onto the Rapture's weak spot.
Its core shatters with a sharp crack, and the Rapture falls silent.
The boy watches wide-eyed as the battered hero walks toward him.
When Ark Ranger Black reaches him, she kneels down on one knee.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... You're not Hope, are you?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: ... No, I'm not.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm Luke. Hope was my twin brother.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I wanted to meet you so I could ask you something.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Why didn't you save Hope, like you just saved me?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: What'd you say...? What kind of a question is that?!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: If you're this strong, why didn't you save Hope?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Hey, kid! Do you have any idea...!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Red.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: But Black...!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Hope really liked the Ark Rangers.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I never really understood what he found so fun about a fake TV show.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But he believed the Ark Rangers were real.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: He always said that if he was ever in danger, they would come and save him.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I knew you were all fakes, though.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: If you were real heroes, you would've saved Hope.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Then who do you think just saved you?!

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Red!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Hey, kid! Take a good look! Look at the shape she's in!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: She practically died saving you, so what's your problem?!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Why didn't you save Hope...?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I bet he was waiting for you, for the Ark Rangers.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Right? So why didn't you save him?

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I... wasn't strong enough.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: If you're not strong, then don't call yourself a hero.
Ark Ranger Black takes out something from her pocket:
Hope's trading card, the plastic case now cracked.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: This is what Hope was holding on to in his final moments.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I want you to have it.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I don't need it!
Luke swings at the card and sends it tumbling across the ground.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: It's stupid! Everything about the Ark Rangers is so stupid!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: What do you even do?! You just wear ridiculous outfits and shout out stupid attack names!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You're not even real heroes! You should be embarrassed!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You couldn't even save Hope! How can you call yourselves heroes?!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You're just a bunch of fakes!
Luke walks away.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Red, Blue.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: What? No. Why should we escort someone home who hates us?

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Come on. He's just a kid.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: The answer's still no.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: I don't want to either.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Fine. I'll go.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: You two take care of Black.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: ... All right. Sorry.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: It's okay. I know all too well what it feels like to be treated unfairly.
Moran starts moving.
She picks up the trading card lying on the ground and tucks it into her clothes.
Then she runs after Luke.
Red and Blue help Black up, propping her up on either side.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: ... You okay?

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Yeah, are you all right?

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: My heart just broke.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: All right. That wraps that up.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... They'll be back, though.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: For sure. This was all about making a breach. They didn't even detonate any chemical weapons.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Next time, I'm sure they'll try to finish things off.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Meaning they're going to try to wipe out the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wipe us all out...?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Well, we could be wrong. I think it's too early to jump to conclusions.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Exactly. They might've been so scared by our show of strength that they don't come near us again.
I somehow doubt that.
The earlier missile strikes were part of a calibration process to more precisely target the Ark.
Once the enemy determined they could reliably hit the Ark, they sent down a weapon to create a breach.
Then they pushed Raptures through that breach, but...
There weren't that many Raptures, and not many high-tier ones either.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's true. If their goal was to seize the Ark by breaching it, they would've launched a larger offensive.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sending Raptures in was likely a distraction to conceal their true intent.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Yeah. If they've got chemical weapons, why make a hole and then send Raptures through? It doesn't make sense.
Their real objective must've been to make a hole and then detonate one or more of those chemical weapons above it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: That makes sense. With a hole that big, whatever chemicals they're using would go right in.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Which means before long, there will be more Raptures...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: And a chemical attack.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Exactly. And we're stuck just waiting here for it.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: The Ark really can't catch a break, can it?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: No kidding... This is super scary. I'm worried.

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: No problème, mes amis! We have une new opération waiting for us!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Gah! You scared me!
Mustang, did you manage to get things sorted out over there?

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: Oui! The Ark Rangers are heading à la surface.
... What?

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: For the détails, read le document d'opération!
Just hold on a second. Why are the Ark Rangers...

lines.speaker: mustang_op
lines.text: Au revoir!
*Beep*

lines.speaker: ingrid_op_r
lines.text: Sounds like Mustang left. Thank goodness. That man is far too loud.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Instructor.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op_r
lines.text: Counters, proceed immediately to the coordinates I'm about to transmit.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op_r
lines.text: Hold your position there until you receive further instructions.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op_r
lines.text: A detailed briefing will be delivered by the operation leader.

lines.speaker: ingrid_op_r
lines.text: Move out at once. Time is of the essence. Over and out.
*Beep*
What is going on...?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Unbelievable. I can't believe an operation like that was actually approved.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It can only signifier one thing: everyone understands la gravité de la situation in the Ark.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Here in the Ark, bad news is abondant.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: With the Third Surface Reclamation War à l'horizon, we have to maintenir our momentum.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Un concert organisé by Tetra is not enough to dispel the fear that grips la population at this moment.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: That may be true,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but turning a Rapture invasion into a TV show is far too risky.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If this fails, we'll lose more than we could gain if it doesn't.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Do not worry! This will be un succès! We will not fail...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: because the Ark has les héros!
